definitions.explanation: The blanket-like covering used on top of the body when sleeping, as opposed to the mattress ({敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}) underneath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use a thick comforter in winter.

examples.japanese: {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}して→干す：00115_hosu⟧⟦ふかふか→ふかふか：10475_fukafuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I aired out the comforter to make it fluffy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{羽毛|うもう}→羽毛：13915_umou⟧{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}くて→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: A down comforter is light and warm.

notes:
{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん} is the covering layer of Japanese bedding — the quilt, comforter, or duvet that goes over the sleeper.

Formation: {掛|か}け, from ⟦{掛|か}ける→掛ける：00854_kakeru⟧ 'to hang or drape over,' + ⟦{布団|ぶとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧. Literally the 'draping futon,' as against the ⟦{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}→敷き布団：07015_shikibuton⟧ or 'spread-out futon' underneath. The pair is the basic division of a futon set: one to lie on, one to lie under.

Collocations:
- {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掛|か}ける→掛ける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put the comforter over oneself
- {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: to air the comforter, typically over a balcony rail on a fine day
- ⟦{羽毛|うもう}→羽毛：13915_umou⟧{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}: down comforter
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}: a thin summer comforter

Related words:
- ⟦{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}→敷き布団：07015_shikibuton⟧: the mattress futon underneath
- ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧: a blanket, often used between the two
- {布団|ぶとん}⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧: the removable cover, washed far more often than the futon itself
